feedback_by_option.fil: Huwag maantala sa home remedy kapag hirap sa paghinga.
feedback_by_option.en: Do not delay referral for home remedies when breathing is difficult.

feedback_by_option.fil: Tama. Maaaring malubhang allergy ang pantal na may hirap sa paghinga; humingi agad ng emergency help.
feedback_by_option.en: Correct. Hives with breathing difficulty may be a severe allergic reaction; activate emergency help immediately.

feedback_by_option.fil: Hindi karaniwang tusok ang hirap sa paghinga. Humingi agad ng emergency help.
feedback_by_option.en: Breathing difficulty is not a routine local sting. Call emergency help now.

feedback_by_option.fil: Huwag magbigay ng gamot nang walang training at pahintulot. Bantayan ang paghinga habang paparating ang tulong.
feedback_by_option.en: Do not give a drug outside training and authorization. Keep watching breathing while help comes.

feedback_by_option.fil: Hindi pahintulot ang pagkakaroon ng gamot sa kit. Manatili sa training at protocol.
feedback_by_option.en: Having a medicine in the kit is not authorization to give it. Stay within training and protocol.

feedback_by_option.fil: Tama. Sundin ang iniresetang emergency plan ng tao at ang sanay/lokal na protocol, at bantayan ang paghinga.
feedback_by_option.en: Correct. Follow the person's prescribed emergency plan and trained/local protocol, and keep watching breathing.
